ES-01.nom: Trina Solar Vertex N high-performance solar panel, 630 to 650 W
ES-01.description: Grade A high-performance commercial panel, next-generation monocrystalline, bifacial double glass. It also captures light reflected from the ground and produces up to 20% more energy. Built to withstand sea salt, sand and hot climates, it is ideal for rooftops and solar farms in Haiti.
